name: tool_failed

question.instructions: Did this coding-agent tool call fail?

criteria.true: the tool call failed: it errored, was rejected, timed out or did not do what it was asked
criteria.false: the tool call succeeded, even if its output mentions errors in content it found or printed

notes: surface_property: failure is usually visible on the surface of the output (tracebacks, exit codes, 'not found'), with decoy successes that mention 'error'. Predicted: both understudies graduate; understudy's max pooling may help on long outputs where the error is buried.
